title: CatalogSkillWire
description: The wire projection of an engine Skill, served in a v2 catalog pull. The ETag content projection hashes exactly eight fields, canonicalizing an omitted or null searchableDescription to null; a source MAY carry additional fields (a conforming client ignores them), but none may carry a secret.

name.description: kebab-case, unique within the project's resolved set

searchableDescription.description: Optional override for the description component used by local retrieval. Omitted or null means use description; name and tags remain indexed.

tools.description: referenced tool ids, resolved against the client-owned registry
